It was agreed the report quantity CLI-RSSI and CLI-SRS-RSRP are included in the higher layer parameter reportQuantity. In the legacy L1-RSRP report and Rel-16 CLI report, the measurement results of more than one resource can be reported. This should also be supported for L1-based CLI report. The number of the measurement results can be the same as the L1-RSRP report, i.e., 4. For the reporting criteria, the highest measurement result should be reported, which is the same as the Rel-16 CLI report. Proposal 22: The UE should report N highest measurement results, where N<=4 and is configured in reportConfig.
